nodes.name: Build Poll Query
nodes.notes: Reads/advances staticData.lastSeenTs. Applies a 30s overlap so events that were still open (end_time null) on the previous poll get re-fetched once they complete; id-based dedupe downstream guarantees they are never double-counted.

nodes.name: Prepare New Events
nodes.notes: Advances the lastSeenTs cursor and filters to completed, not-yet-processed events, one item per event. This is the same cursor/dedupe logic that used to live at the top of the old 'Classify, Dedupe & Count' node -- unchanged behavior, just split out so each new event can be routed through its own 'Fetch Timeline' call before classification.

nodes.name: Fetch Timeline
nodes.notes: Runs once per new event (one input item per event from 'Prepare New Events'). options.response.response.fullResponse=true is REQUIRED: verified empirically that without it, n8n's HTTP Request node auto-splits each event's N-entry timeline JSON array into N separate output items with sequential/bogus pairedItem indices, which silently mismatches timeline entries to the wrong event whenever 2+ events are in flight in the same poll. With fullResponse:true, this node emits exactly one output item per input item (body holds the raw timeline array), and pairedItem.item correctly indexes back into 'Prepare New Events' -- used downstream in 'Classify, Dedupe & Count'.

nodes.name: Classify, Dedupe & Count
nodes.notes: Transition-sum classifier over each event's Frigate timeline (entered_zone entries), replacing the old event.zones-based classifier. See README 'Why event.zones was abandoned' -- event.zones records only each zone's FIRST entry and cannot represent a round trip (out and back in nets to zero crossings recorded, misread as EXIT). Pairs timeline responses back to their source event via pairedItem.item (see 'Fetch Timeline' node notes), not array order.

nodes.name: Push to Gotify
nodes.notes: Auth: Query Auth credential 'Gotify Token' (query param name 'token'). This node runs once per NEW completed event from 'Classify, Dedupe & Count' -- zero items means zero pushes.

nodes.name: Apply Manual Reset
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/occupancy/reset?count=N forces occupancy to N (floored at 0). Missing/non-numeric count returns ok:false with HTTP 200 rather than a 4xx -- see README. stats=1 also clears entered/left/roundTrips/unclear.
